title: Spec and quiz page
caption: Hands-on 1b: finish the interview, write the spec, build the quiz page, and swap with a partner.

steps.first: Finish “Grill me” in the chat you left open.
steps.second: Step “Write the spec”: copy the prompt; the AI turns your answers into a short spec.
steps.third: Step “Build the quiz”: in a fresh chat, the spec becomes one HTML page you open by double-click.
steps.fourth: Play it, then share the page and your prompt with a partner and compare.

done: A quiz page on your laptop that a partner has played.

workflow.label: Open the quiz Workflow
workflow.pick: On the page, pick “Turn a source into a quiz”. Each step there has the prompt to copy, in a chat version and one for an agent.

help.label: Where you're stuck
help.placeholder: Paste what the AI answered, or describe where you're stuck…
help.copyTip: Paste this prompt into an AI you are allowed to use.
help.noError: (I haven't pasted anything yet: ask me what I see.)

chats.openAIChatTip: Open an empty {chat} chat in a new tab, then paste the prompt

help.step: Stage 1 and 2: Write the spec, Build the quiz, Play it and fix it

talking-points.description: Building in a fresh chat from the spec is the point of the day: the spec carries the shared understanding, not the long interview. If a page does not open, the Help prompt explains the error in plain words.
